attestations.note: The listing names the three women in one line and the life page behind it tells each of them apart, so this is one folder per member. The page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year. The corpus keeps no Kyprilla and no Cyprilla of any spelling; the Cyprians the name sweep offered are a different name and none is on this day. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
